title: Probability-functions polytope of a three-element antichain

source.citation: Jan Snellman, The Polytope of Probability Functions on a Finite Poset, arXiv:2502.01604

translation.notes: The paper identifies the three-antichain probability-functions polytope with a three-cube. The solution independently constructs the antichain and exact cube and verifies the claim through Noether; no ancillary Sage code is copied.
